scorecard.rationale: Baseline Parkinson walking difficulty was inversely associated with unspecified olive oil. The oldest-old study combined oil with other items. The newly recovered two-country analysis related a whole Mediterranean diet score and its fat ratio to walking and disability. High versus low score in the US timed-walk model gave an OR for slower walking of 0.753 after cognition adjustment, with a 95% CI of 0.540 to 1.049. The text and continuous-score direction differ. This cannot allocate an oil effect. Obesity and sarcopenia gait studies remain inconclusive, and the Buriram trial used a shared sublingual oil vehicle. PRIME studies mobility within a dietary intervention. Cold-pressed olive oil and clinical Parkinson walking speed remain unresolved.
